analysis: Existing cache quality controls, no new chess engine analysis

method.cache_claimed_engine: Stockfish 19 according to review script; cache lacks engine binary digest/version/depth/date and nodes fields.
method.cache_match_validation: Exact whole-game UCI list, actor list, and learner color against frozen Oct15 ledgers.
method.periods: Primary split at floor(last cached game number / 2); sensitivity compares first and last third. No uncached late games are assessed.
method.strata: Exact opponent id/options, color, and nodes_per_move; only strata present in both periods.
method.weights: Pooled game counts in overlapping strata, fixed for both periods; within stratum each game has equal weight.
method.uncertainty: 6000 stratified game bootstrap replicates; moves never treated as independent observations; six-game block sensitivity for comparisons with at least 35 games per period; seed 20261015.
method.balanced: Before-move cached eval between -200 and +200cp inclusive, from mover perspective.
method.first12: First 12 actual own moves of each game, including all shorter games with their actual opportunities. Count short games explicitly.
method.severe_cp_loss: Before-after >=200cp on a single model move; balanced controls avoid arbitrary mate averages and lost-position saturation.
method.proxy: 100/(1+exp(-0.00368208*clip(cp,-1500,1500))); a bounded display proxy, not calibrated win probability.
method.legacy_acpl: Positive loss after clipping before and after separately to +/-1000cp; descriptive saturation-sensitive comparator only.
limits: Posthoc observational comparisons are not randomized interventions.
Game clustering allows within-game dependence, not shared opening/serial dependence across games; intervals can be optimistic.
Balanced positions remain selected by previous play; first12 and any-error-per-game controls reduce but do not eliminate survivorship.
200k-node fixed-position cache is noisy, single-PV best-match is not a count of uniquely correct moves.
Existing analysis script does not clear the transposition table between games/positions; cached values can depend on earlier engine state.
Many metrics and periods examined; no multiplicity-corrected causal significance claims.
Small-prefix caches cannot test the completed runs: Sol33/200, Sol-long16/99, Fable15/45, Sol-long-max0/63.

bootstrap_diagnostics.interpretation: Game-cluster intervals describe sampling variation conditional on these periods/configurations; serial dependence remains unmodeled.
